products.name: IFB Executive ZBN Laundrimagic 9/6/3 kg washer dryer refresher with Ai Dry
products.summary: Open the door to see the drum, pull out the detergent drawer and open the pump-filter door, then place it in your home at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap the door, the drawer or the round flap to open it
products.sizeNote: IFB gives 66.7 cm deep on its product page and 62.1 cm for the cabinet in its manual; here the door stands in front of the cabinet to the 66.7 cm
specs: 9 kg wash, 6 kg dry, 3 kg steam refresh
Eco Inverter Motor, 10 years motor warranty
Ai Dry, Cupboard Dry, Iron Dry, Time Dry; Wash + Dry in 2 or 4 hours; Spin & Dry
Steam Refresh in 30 minutes, with just steam, no water or detergent
10 on the machine plus 12 in the My IFB app
Ai, Power Steam, 9 Swirl Wash, Turbo Spray, 3D Wash System, Time Saver, Aqua Energie, Laundry Add
Wi-Fi and voice through the My IFB app
Touch keys and a chrome dial, large 7-segment LED display
Hinged on the left, 320 mm opening
220-240 V, single phase, 50 Hz; 2000 W heater
4 years on the machine, 10 years on the motor, 10 years spare parts support

hotspots.title: Ai Dry
hotspots.text: Automatically stops the drying cycle the moment your clothes are completely dry, which helps prevent over-drying, protects fabrics and saves energy.

hotspots.title: Steam Refresh with Dry Mode
hotspots.text: Clothes that are fresh, free of odour and wrinkles in just 30 minutes, with just steam: no water or detergent.

hotspots.title: 9 Swirl Wash
hotspots.text: Mimics hand wash motions to give your clothes the care they deserve.

hotspots.title: Eco Inverter Motor
hotspots.text: Consumes up to 40% less energy, and the washer operates quietly with minimal vibration.

fit.note: IFB's manual asks for at least 10 cm between the back and the wall. IFB publishes no gap for the sides, and no depth with the door open: leave room in front to open the door and to pull out the drawer.
